args.command:
cd . && python << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
smi = "CC(C)(C)C(=O->[Ni]1(<-[C]2N(c3c(C)cc(C)cc3C)CCN2c2c(C)cc(C)cc2C))O[C@@H](c2ccccc2)c2cc3ccccc3cc21"
m = Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=0xf00d; ps.useRandomCoords=True
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,30,ps)
print(len(cids))
# pick conformer with best Ni geometry: roughly planar 3-coord
ni=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='Ni'][0]
best=None
for c in cids:
    conf=m.GetConformer(c)
    p=lambda i: np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))
    nb=[n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(ni).GetNeighbors()]
    v=[p(x)-p(ni) for x in nb]
    d=[np.linalg.norm(x) for x in v]
    # sum of angles ~360 for planar
    ang=0
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(i+1,3):
            ang+=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(v[i],v[j])/(d[i]*d[j])))
    print(c,[round(x,2) for x in d], round(ang,1))
    if best is None or ang>best[1]: best=(c,ang)
print('best',best)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'init.mol',confId=best[0])
# write xyz
conf=m.GetConformer(best[0])
with open('start.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nstart\n")
    for a in m.GetAtoms():
        pos=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f"{a.GetSymbol()} {pos.x:.4f} {pos.y:.4f} {pos.z:.4f}\n")
EOF
